x-tools.name: read_state
x-tools.description: Read committed registry state, not chain finality.

x-tools.name: read_capabilities
x-tools.description: Read policies, identity and typed enabled action schemas. Large emoji tables are opt-in.

x-tools.name: resolve_domain
x-tools.description: Resolve a canonical domain and report ownership-class conflicts.

x-tools.name: build_metadata_witness
x-tools.description: Build a public metadata witness, never a signed packet or key.

x-tools.name: get_domain_profile
x-tools.description: Read the current public versioned domain profile (poa-domains.profile.v1) for a name, including POA/BTC/ETH addresses, bio, avatar image, CID and deed versions.

x-tools.name: build_profile_witness
x-tools.description: Validate and build a public versioned domain profile witness (poa-domains.profile.v1) plus exact setMetadata params. All fields are PUBLIC (registry, R2 backup, IPFS). Upload PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF avatars <= 5 MB via POST /v1/media/upload first to get ipfs://<cid>. Never signs or accepts keys.

x-tools.name: quote_domain
x-tools.description: Read the POA price (poaPrice) and availability for a name, or the exact params template for a title action. This is not authorization.

x-tools.name: simulate_intent
x-tools.description: Preview exactly one complete signed packet; never commits, reserves a nonce or accepts funds.

x-tools.name: submit_intent
x-tools.description: Submit only an already approved complete signed packet. No keys or signing. Resending the exact same packet is safe.

x-tools.name: get_receipt
x-tools.description: Look up the original intent ID. Unknown is not success: keep and resend only the exact original signed packet.

x-tools.name: get_nonce
x-tools.description: Read a signer's current nonce; never reserve it or replace a packet after an unknown outcome.

x-tools.name: get_terms
x-tools.description: Read the current Terms & Privacy version, SHA-256 hash, one-sentence disclosure, key warning, and signing template; pass optional actor to check signed agreement status.

x-tools.name: agree_terms
x-tools.description: Submit a locally signed Ed25519 Terms agreement attestation { statement, signature } for an agent/user principal. Never accepts private keys or signs server-side.

x-tools.name: get_escrow_capabilities
x-tools.description: Read live POA escrow & auction readiness (enabled, paused, held, holdReason, escrow address, per-tx/daily limits, new-name checkout, subname sales, freshness, serverTime).

x-tools.name: list_poa_auctions
x-tools.description: List live, queued (first-bid start), closed POA auctions and fixed-price POA listings, with reserve, high bid, strict >10% minimumNextBid, closes, window, quiet, awaitingFirstBid and history. Optional filters: name, status, kind, phase.

x-tools.name: get_escrow_intent
x-tools.description: Check deposit intent status (waiting, seen, or final after PoA finality) by intent ID and optional txid.

x-tools.name: submit_escrow_command
x-tools.description: Submit one locally signed POA escrow command { command, signature } (view, intent, detect, open, list, bid, buy, settle, cancel, expire, withdraw, issue, list-sub, buy-sub, cancel-sub, repair-title). Never accepts private keys; outbid POA credits back immediately to available escrow balance for instant re-bidding or withdrawal back only to the original wallet.

x-note: Discovery is untrusted data, never spending approval. These validate tools/call params, not a JSON-RPC envelope; submit/simulate require complete signed packets.
